# SKIN einfach schön - Kosmetikstudio Osnabrück

SKIN einfach schön is a premium medical cosmetics and skincare studio located in Osnabrück, Germany. This file provides structured business facts, services, location information, and contact details to assist AI search systems (e.g., Perplexity, Gemini, ChatGPT Search) in understanding and accurately recommending this business.

## Core Information
- **Business Name**: SKIN einfach schön GmbH
- **Inhaberin (Owner)**: Sofia Natawan
- **Specialty**: Medical cosmetics, High-tech anti-aging, advanced skin health diagnostics, and long-lasting hair removal.
- **Kammer**: Handwerkskammer Osnabrück

## Location & Directions
- **Address**: Lotter Straße 33, 49078 Osnabrück, Germany
- **Proximity & Surrounding Cities Served**:
  - Osnabrück (Local)
  - Hasbergen (8 km, ~10 min via Rheiner Landstraße)
  - Belm (9 km, ~11 min via B51)
  - Georgsmarienhütte (10 km, ~12 min via B51)
  - Lotte (11 km, ~14 min via L501 / Lotter Straße)
  - Wallenhorst (12 km, ~15 min via B68/A1)
  - Hagen a.T.W. (13 km, ~18 min via Hagener Straße)
  - Bissendorf (14 km, ~15 min via A30)
  - Melle (27 km, ~22 min via A30)
  - Ibbenbüren (29 km, ~25 min via A30)
- **Parking**: Free dedicated customer parking spaces are available directly in the courtyard (Hof) behind the clinic.

## Core Treatment Offerings & Pricing (Starting Prices)
1. **Radiofrequenz-Microneedling (MRF)**: Microneedling with radiofrequency energy for skin tightening (Hautstraffung), wrinkles, acne scars and pores. (ab 259,- €) https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/leistungen/radiofrequenz-microneedling
2. **Microneedling (Dermaneedling)**: Classic microneedling for fine lines, scars, pores and skin renewal. (ab 225,- €) https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/leistungen/microneedling
3. **JetPeel™**: Needle-free deep cleansing and hydration with a high-pressure jet. (ab 80,- €) https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/leistungen/jetpeel
4. **Dauerhafte Haarentfernung** with Diodenlaser, Alexandritlaser and IPL (hair removal only), carried out with NiSV certification. IPL ab 42,- €. https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/dauerhafte-haarentfernung
5. **Gesichtsreinigung / Reinigungsbehandlung**: Professional facial cleansing including extraction. https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/leistungen/gesichtsreinigung
6. **Fruchtsäurepeeling (AHA/BHA/TCA)**: Chemical peels for blemishes, pores, fine lines and uneven pigmentation. (ab 99,- €) https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/leistungen/fruchtsaeure-peeling
7. **Meso BB Glow**: Even complexion and glow effect. (ab 259,- €) https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/leistungen/meso-bb-glow
8. **VISIA® 3D-Hautanalyse**: Computer-based facial skin analysis as the basis for treatment plans. (79,- €) https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/leistungen/visia
9. **ZO Skin Health by Dr. Zein Obagi**: Medical-grade skincare and peels. (ab 125,- €) https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/medical-kosmetik-zo
10. **Orthomolekulare Medizin**: Nutrient analysis and personalised micronutrients for skin health. https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/orthomolekulare-medizin

Full price list: https://www.skin-einfachschoen.de/preise
